jobs.occupation: Dishwasher
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for dedicated dishwashers to our French Bistro & Spanish Bar,

- looking for you, who want to be an important part of our committed team.

Available, is both full time positions and part time positions.

As Dishwasher at our places, you must be efficient, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced kitchen environment. Your job is to help keep our kitchen clean and running smoothly, so our chefs can focus on creating delicious food and our waiters can focus on welcoming guests with warmth, generosity and care.

Who we are;

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly popular and busy. Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have. Klassisk 65 being the characteristic charming French bistro and Bar´ Habla, our lively and colorful Spanish Bar.

We are a wonderful diverse international team, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, - charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organization is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We’re looking for someone who:

·       Speaks English, it’s a must! (Danish is a plus)

·       Is responsible, reliable, fast learner and works independently

·       Is able to keep calm, move fast, and keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

·       Is punctual and dependable

·       Has a positive attitude and can handle physical tasks

·       Preferably has experience in the restaurant/and or cleaning industry

·       Can work either full time or part time, evenings and weekends

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in complying with company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid and have development plans)

·       We teach you, the first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       An opportunity to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food when working

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Please, only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay until your shift ends at night/after midnight. Its non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role Dishwasher & if you seek parttime or full time. 

If your header is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

jobs.occupation: Senior auto mechanic / technician
jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled senior technician/automechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,400 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

• 
Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems

• 
Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

• 
Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors

• 
Servicing and repairing AC pumps and climate systems

• 
Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

• 
Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a trained passenger car mechanic or have an equivalent technical background

• 
Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

• 
Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

• 
Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

• 
Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

• 
Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

• 
To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

• 
An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

• 
Ongoing training and good development opportunities

• 
A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

• 
Attractive terms of employment

• 
A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

We build in a field that changes every few weeks, and we are now looking for a top-notch student worker to make that visible.

THE ROLE

ABOUT HUMAN THINKING (THE COMPANY) AND CHATTUTOR (THE PRODUCT)

Human Thinking builds tools that keep people thinking when they work with AI. Our motto is Human Thinking. AI Assisted.

ChatTutor is our product for education. It lets a teacher decide how the AI behaves in their own course, grounded in their own material and their own didactics, and lets them follow the students' conversations and step in where it makes sense. Practically that means custom PDF parsing for equation-heavy STEM material, an escalation path to the human teacher, and an annotation system that carries good answers forward from semester to semester. We are a small team out of Nørrebro, Copenhagen, working with universities and educational institutions, and a published study in Educational Psychology Review found students learned more with ChatTutor than with ChatGPT.

The product works. Now we need more of the right people to know it exists.

THE ROLE

You will run our outreach engine: the repeatable, measurable machine that turns strangers into conversations and conversations into pipeline. This is not a "help out with marketing" role - it is one system, with numbers attached, and you own the weekly operation of it.

Most of the work is disciplined execution: the engine only compounds if someone runs it every week without dropping days. If you like seeing a chart go up because of something you did a few days before, this is your kind of job.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• 
Outbound on LinkedIn: help run daily outreach - connection requests and messages - from our team's LinkedIn profiles. Target warm leads only - a well-chosen list beats a big one. Write and iterate the message sequences, and track what actually gets replies.

• 
Outbound email: operate and scale our outbound email programme, including list building, sequencing, deliverability and inbox health. Keep every send inside GDPR and the Danish Marketing Practices Act - we would rather send fewer emails than cross the lines.

• 
LinkedIn content engine: plan and publish a high-frequency posting schedule across our team's profiles - one post per profile per day, across six profiles. Six days a week is lead-magnet content; one day a week is founder story. Coordinate around influencer posts with partners in the education space.

• 
Reddit: grow our presence properly - warm up the account first, post roughly three times a week, tell real stories, give away useful blueprints. Never take the bait: you do not debate the haters.

• 
SEO and long-tail content: produce content targeting competitor keywords and the questions educators actually type into Google. Help grow organic traffic and report on what is moving.

• 
Paid social: run Facebook retargeting and acquisition campaigns, and keep an honest eye on cost per lead.

You will not do all six at full intensity in week one. We will start with the two that move fastest and add from there.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 
You are currently enrolled as a student and can commit 7-10 hours a week over a longer period.

• 
You are consistent. This role rewards someone who shows up on the quiet weeks, not someone who does a brilliant burst and disappears.

• 
You are comfortable with numbers - open rates, reply rates, CTR, cost per lead - and you form opinions from them.

• 
You write clearly and briefly. Most of this job is short-form persuasive writing, on a deadline, at volume.

• 
You already use AI tools for research, drafting and automation, or you will pick them up fast.

• 
You work independently. With 7-10 hours a week, we need someone who ships without being managed through every step.

• 
Danish and English both at a high level is a strong advantage. Interest in education, EdTech or AI is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 
5,000-8,000 DKK per month for 7-10 hours a week, depending on experience.

• 
Real ownership of a growth channel from day one, with direct access to the founding team.

• 
A rare thing for a student job: you will see the whole funnel, from first touch to signed institution.

• 
Hands-on experience with modern outbound and AI tooling.

• 
Flexible hours that fit around your studies and exam periods.

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to hello@chattutor.io with the subject line "Student Worker – Growth & Outreach":

• 
The short assignment below. This matters more to us than your CV.

• 
A few lines on who you are, why this role, and any growth or outreach work you have done before - including things that did not work.

• 
Your CV and your LinkedIn profile.

THE ASSIGNMENT

Spend half an hour on chattutor.io, then send us the following on a single page:

• 
One target segment. Who would you go after first, and why them before anyone else?

• 
One LinkedIn DM. Written to a real person in that segment - 80 words or fewer. Tell us who it is addressed to.

One lead magnet idea. What would you give away that an educator would actually download, and what makes it worth their email address?

One number. What would you measure in the first month to know whether any of this is working?

Short and sharp beats long and thorough. We are reading for judgment, not effort.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a more sustainable built environment to apply for a PhD position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings. The position is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 23:59 CET/CEST.

 

Scope of the work

The PhD position is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. The overall ambition is to develop a new generation of low-carbon prefabricated building systems enabled by 3D concrete printing, rethinking how concrete structures are designed, fabricated, and assembled.

The research will bring together architectural design, structural optimisation, and artificial intelligence to generate materially efficient building systems in which geometry, structural performance, and fabrication are developed as an integrated whole. It will address advanced toolpath generation, reinforcement integration, structural connections, and assembly through unified computational design and robotic fabrication workflows.

The candidate will develop artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting structural evaluation, geometry generation, fabrication planning, and robotic production. The work will combine computational research with extensive laboratory experimentation, including the robotic printing of full-scale components and building demonstrators at SDU CREATE and their validation through structural testing.

The candidate will also contribute to teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through laboratory teaching, workshops, and co-supervision of student projects.

 

Focus Area and Research Project

The research focuses on developing the next generation of low-carbon building systems. 3D concrete printing offers significant opportunities for prefabrication, geometric differentiation, and project-specific optimisation. Realising this potential requires an integrated approach in which architectural design, structural performance, robotic fabrication, reinforcement, connections, and assembly are addressed as interdependent aspects of a building system.

The project will develop computational and experimental methods for the design, fabrication, and validation of materially efficient prefabricated building systems. It will extend SDU CREATE’s research on performance-informed architectural design, structural optimisation, hybrid printing, reinforcement integration, and full-scale robotic construction.

The research will address the following areas:

• 
Computational design of architecturally and structurally integrated prefabricated building systems for 3DCP

• 
Structural optimisation at component and system levels, encompassing slabs, beams, columns, walls, nodes, and their connections

• 
Artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting geometry generation, structural evaluation, and fabrication planning

• 
Advanced toolpath generation and sensing-based process control for structurally differentiated components

• 
Integration of reinforcement, structural connections, fabrication constraints, and assembly requirements into robotic production workflows

• 
Robotic 3D printing of full-scale components and construction of integrated building demonstrators

• 
Structural testing of printed components, connections, and assembled systems

•

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, with a focus on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation.  SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable and regenerative approaches to the design and production of the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, concrete mixing and extrusion equipment, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full-scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads the research field on Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to the research field on Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.
